    环境安装

    使用 Python 3.10 与支持 CUDA 的 NVIDIA GPU。在项目根目录运行以下命令；模型权重需单独准备。

    以下步骤面向包含 examples/inference/ 的源码目录。先确认该目录存在，再按本文安装；其他版本的脚本位置以其随附说明为准。

    HccePose 环境

    根据驱动选择适用的 PyTorch CUDA 安装方式，再安装本包依赖：

    BASH
    python -m pip install -r requirements-inference.txt
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip .

    工具包解压后应存在 bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/。接下来按资源说明准备匹配的检测器和各物体的位姿权重。

    可选 WAPR

    RGB-D 示例使用这个固定提交的 WAPR 源码。请在本项目以外的工作目录中使用 Git、Python 3.10 和 Bash 执行以下命令。生成的 wheel 带有本地编译所需的源码。

    BASH
    git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.git WAPR-source
git -C WAPR-source checkout --detach 4e591be318a828c91980c58ef8bbdc34e6599881
python -m pip install "setuptools>=77" "wheel>=0.45"
(cd WAPR-source && WAPR_WHEEL_SOURCE_ONLY=1 python wheel_build/build_wheel.py)
python -m pip install WAPR-source/wheel_build/dist/wapr-0.0.11-py3-none-any.whl

    如在另一台机器构建，将上述 wheel 复制到目标机，把最后一条安装命令中的路径改为目标机上的位置，在 HccePose 使用的同一 Python 环境中安装。目标机需备好含 nvcc 的 CUDA toolkit、C++ 编译器和支持 CUDA 的 PyTorch。Linux 上的 OpenGL 渲染器还需要 EGL/OpenGL 开发头文件。随后准备位姿估计组件：

    BASH
    python -m wapr.bootstrap --feature core

    WAPR 默认将资源放在用户缓存目录中的 wapr/，可选的 WAPR_CACHE_DIR 必须是绝对路径；配置组件和运行推理时应使用同一个值。该目录独立于 HccePose 的 data/ 和 Torch Hub 缓存。以上构建命令使用 Bash；Windows 可使用 Git Bash，并按上游要求准备 MSVC 与 CUDA，不能直接将 Bash 子命令粘贴到 PowerShell。

    首次配置需联网下载公开权重和依赖。请在目标 GPU 上用配套模型和实际输入验证完整流程。详见该版本 WAPR 的安装说明。

    公开训练与渲染源码

    物体准备、PBR 渲染、标签生成、检测器训练、位姿训练和 BOP 评测教程使用公开上游的阶段脚本。将其放在单独的源码目录中，按固定版本运行：

    BASH
    git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git HCCEPose-upstream
cd HCCEPose-upstream
git checkout --detach f75cc4d5db2fc298fc7b853f8c75273757872382
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip .

    这些脚本位于该目录根部，如 s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py、s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py；它们不在当前项目的 examples/inference/ 中。教程链接均指向公开固定版本。阅读各脚本顶部的输入要求，修改用户数据路径后再运行。

    训练和渲染的依赖多于纯推理。PyMeshLab 用于网格预处理，KASAL 用于对称信息；BlenderProc 与 bpy 用于 PBR 渲染。需要渲染时在上游源码根目录执行：

    BASH
    python -m zipfile -e blenderproc.zip .
python -m pip install bpy==3.6.0 --extra-index-url https://download.blender.org/pypi/

    Ubuntu 的 EGL/OpenGL 开发依赖、显卡驱动和 CUDA 必须与选用的软件版本匹配。独立准备训练/渲染环境，不要将上述额外组件作为所有推理用户的必需依赖。各阶段的公开参数与目录见项目结构。

    MegaPose 与网络加速

    MegaPose 可能在首次调用时克隆公开源码，创建 .envs/megapose/ Python 3.9 子环境并下载模型。请确保 Conda 可用、源码目录可写；不要把所有 MegaPose 依赖混装到主环境。用法见 MegaPose 教程。

    ONNX / TensorRT 选择会触发后端环境检查，可能安装依赖、导出模型或构建缓存。需要兼容的 CUDA、ONNX Runtime 和 TensorRT 运行库，详见加速说明。纯 PyTorch RGB 推理不要求安装这些可选后端。

    Installation

    Use Python 3.10 and an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support. Run the following commands from the project root. Prepare model weights separately.

    These steps apply to a source directory containing examples/inference/. Confirm that directory exists before following the instructions; use the accompanying instructions for script locations in other versions.

    HccePose environment

    Install CUDA-enabled PyTorch suitable for your driver, then install the package dependencies:

    BASH
    python -m pip install -r requirements-inference.txt
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip .

    Extraction must create bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/. Next, prepare the matching detector and per-object pose weights described in resource preparation.

    Optional WAPR

    The RGB-D example uses the pinned WAPR source. To build its wheel, run the following Bash commands with Git and Python 3.10 in a working directory outside this project. The wheel contains the sources for the native components.

    BASH
    git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.git WAPR-source
git -C WAPR-source checkout --detach 4e591be318a828c91980c58ef8bbdc34e6599881
python -m pip install "setuptools>=77" "wheel>=0.45"
(cd WAPR-source && WAPR_WHEEL_SOURCE_ONLY=1 python wheel_build/build_wheel.py)
python -m pip install WAPR-source/wheel_build/dist/wapr-0.0.11-py3-none-any.whl

    If you build on a different machine, copy the wheel named above to the target and run the last installation command with its local path in the same Python environment as HccePose. On the target, prepare a CUDA toolkit with nvcc, a C++ compiler and CUDA-enabled PyTorch. On Linux the OpenGL renderer also needs EGL/OpenGL development headers. Then prepare the pose estimation components:

    BASH
    python -m wapr.bootstrap --feature core

    WAPR stores resources under wapr/ in the user cache directory by default. The optional WAPR_CACHE_DIR must be an absolute path; use the same value for component setup and inference. This directory is separate from HccePose’s data/ and the Torch Hub cache. The build commands above use Bash. On Windows, use Git Bash and prepare MSVC and CUDA as required upstream; do not paste the Bash subshell command directly into PowerShell.

    The first setup needs network access to fetch the published weights and dependencies. Test the complete setup on the target GPU with your models and inputs. See the setup notes for this WAPR revision.

    Public training and rendering source

    Object preparation, PBR rendering, labeling, detector training, pose training and BOP evaluation use stage scripts from public upstream. Place that source in a separate directory and select the documented revision:

    BASH
    git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git HCCEPose-upstream
cd HCCEPose-upstream
git checkout --detach f75cc4d5db2fc298fc7b853f8c75273757872382
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip .

    Stage scripts such as s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py and s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py live in that root, rather than the current project’s examples/inference/. Tutorial links use the fixed public revision. Read the input requirements and edit user data paths before launching each stage.

    Training and rendering require more dependencies than inference. PyMeshLab prepares meshes, KASAL describes symmetries, and BlenderProc with bpy renders PBR scenes. For rendering, run in the upstream root:

    BASH
    python -m zipfile -e blenderproc.zip .
python -m pip install bpy==3.6.0 --extra-index-url https://download.blender.org/pypi/

    Ubuntu EGL/OpenGL development libraries, drivers and CUDA must match your software choices. Prepare training/rendering environments separately rather than making all these components mandatory for inference. See Project structure for stages, public parameters and layouts.

    MegaPose and network acceleration

    First use of MegaPose may clone public source, create a Python 3.9 environment under .envs/megapose/, and download models. Ensure Conda is available and the source directory is writable. Keep MegaPose dependencies separate from the main environment; see the MegaPose tutorial.

    ONNX / TensorRT selection triggers environment checks that may install packages, export networks or build caches. Compatible CUDA, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT libraries are required; see acceleration. Plain PyTorch RGB inference does not require these optional backends.
